facts.fact: The Liberian Observer reports that stakeholders met on 17 December 2024 to validate the draft Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act of 2024, written by the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications with Internews and EU funding, and says Liberia has no standalone data protection law.
